props.name: aria-label
props.description: The Sparkline's name. A Sparkline is an image with no keyboard stop, and its accessible name is this text followed by the generated range sentence, which names the lowest and highest values.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the part's element.

props.name: color
props.description: The paint. "chart-1" by default.

props.name: curve
props.description: The curve through the values. "monotone" by default.

props.name: data
props.description: Evenly spaced values. Null leaves a gap. No values, or only nulls, draw nothing and read the dictionary's `noData`.

props.name: data-hover
props.description: "none" leaves hover out. With hover, a pointer over a value shows a dashed crosshair and a dot there, fades the rest of the series and draws the line around the value, or the value's bar, at full strength, and moving to the next value cross-fades the marks. The hover is CSS, shows only on a device that hovers, and adds no tab stop and nothing to the accessible name. It writes a region of about half a kilobyte and five elements per value, so a 30-value line is about 18 KB and 150 elements with it and 1.4 KB and 3 elements without, and a 168-value line about 106 KB against 7 KB. Pass "none" where many Sparklines render at once, such as one per row of a long table.

props.name: data-intro
props.description: "none" turns the entrance off. A line wipes in from the left, an area fills behind it, and bars grow from the baseline. The entrance plays whenever the svg enters the document, so it replays when the element is inserted again, as a keyed row that a sort moves or a panel shown again is. Pass "none" where that happens, such as a Sparkline in a sortable table. Reduced motion draws the marks at rest either way.

props.name: description
props.description: Replaces the generated range sentence verbatim.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: A dot on one value, by keyword or by index.

props.name: format
props.description: How the range sentence prints values.

props.name: id
props.description: The svg's id.

props.name: interval
props.description: Each value's slot length. Pass it with `start` and `timeZone`.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the range sentence. Sparkline calls no hook, so a server component renders it with no client JavaScript, and it cannot read LocaleProvider.

props.name: reference
props.description: A flat dashed line, such as Norgespris against spot.

props.name: start
props.description: The first value's slot start. Pass `start`, `interval` and `timeZone` together, and the range sentence names the slots of the lowest and highest values. Without them it names no slots.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles, with every public chart custom property typed.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The IANA zone the slot labels read in. Pass it with `start` and `interval`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The mark. "line" by default. An area fades from its values toward 0, above and below the zero line, and an engine that masks no SVG element, such as WebKit, keeps a flat 0.3 fill. A bar rounds the corners of its far end by `--chart-bar-radius`.

props.name: children
props.description: One or more `Sparkline`s, whose hover marks glide on a spring once the wrapper hydrates. A server component can render the wrapper around server-rendered Sparklines, and the data stays on the server. Before it hydrates, or with no script, the Sparklines keep their CSS hover. A step to another value glides the crosshair, the dot and the band that re-strokes a line or an area, and a hovered bar lifts at once. Under reduced motion the marks move at once. A Sparkline inside nested wrappers follows the nearest one, and the wrapper leaves a Sparkline with `data-hover="none"` alone. Pass `render` to put the behavior on another element, such as the tile that holds the Sparklines.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
